newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle steady at $108/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle steady at $108/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were steady on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), according to USDA.
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs 106.00- 108.00; string 109.00. ( weighted average 107.87 ).
Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 106.00- 108.00. ( weighted average 107.67 )

Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested on a live basis, but few sales near steady. Demand uneven, but fairly good to several packers. Seller interest decent at top side of quotes. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 65.00-67.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1175 lbs 65.00- 67.00.
For the week - Slaughter steers and heifers on a live and dressed basis steady. Weekly total includes 13,400 formulated and previously contracted cattle.
Wk To Date- 51,500 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 69,800 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 84,500
